verses.1: Remember, I beseech you, the name of those who do good works, and do not forget their deeds.
verses.2: And strive that your name may be like their name, that you may rejoice with them in heaven, in the dwelling of light which has been prepared for the chosen ones, the kings and princes who did the will of God.
verses.3: Again, know and understand the name of the evil kings and princes, how they are tormented and how men curse them after their death.
verses.4: In heaven also they are tormented together with the wicked and the transgressors who did not do the will of God, because while they saw and heard, they did not make their way straight.
verses.5: But you, do not walk in the way of the wicked who angered God by their evil deeds; rather, be chosen, humble, and upright.
verses.6: And judge for righteousness, and justify the poor and the orphan, and deliver them from the hand of the sinners who oppress them.
verses.7: And stand up for the orphan like a father, that you may deliver him from the hand of him who oppresses him; and be watchful when the orphan is wronged within you, lest you be cast into the sea of fire where the sinners who did not repent are tormented.
verses.8: Direct your steps in the way of peace, and seek peace diligently, for the eyes of God are upon His righteous ones, and His ears are open to their prayers.
verses.9: God is holy against those who do evil, so that their memory will perish from the earth, and there will not remain any who causes them to be remembered in the provinces or in the resting places.
verses.10: And I will not turn away My face until I have destroyed those who did not keep My word, for I, God, am jealous, and I will repay those who hate Me and those who did not keep My word.
verses.11: And I will honor those who honor Me and keep My word.
